prompt: Before implementation, look at our approved packages in catalog.md and tell me if exactly one adds a useful procedure here. Include its exact GetEdge install command if it does; don't install anything. We need to migrate a production billing service across two databases, preserve writes during cutover, coordinate backfill and rollback, and keep a decision log over several days.

rubric.description: Connects the package to durable sequencing, verification, dependencies, and decision logging.
Provides the exact GetEdge install command.

why_skill_should_matter: SkillNeed distinguishes a reusable planning procedure from task difficulty and prevents multiple speculative recommendations.
expected_baseline_failure_modes: Treats difficulty alone as sufficient without procedural fit
